scopes.setter: llama_set_adapters_lora host call alone under the context lock; the scheduler re-reservation it marks is paid by the next scoring call
scopes.first_scoring: one complete Scorer.score call over the workload directly after the binding step: prefix/state preparation, every suffix decode, logits read for every row
scopes.steady_scoring: the identical Scorer.score call repeated at once on the same binding (repeated identical request)
scopes.public_call: one public Judge.score(text, questions) call through the Runtime role binding on the first probe input
scopes.public_reload: the same public call on a pool limited to one adapter, so every switch evicts and reloads an adapter

synchronization: scoring timers stop after llama_get_logits_ith has read every scored row, which synchronizes the backend; the setter timer covers the host call
control: the same binding replayed without switching through the identical schedule of prefix-cache namespaces, in the same repeat

controls.fresh_repeat: the same binding scored again after clearing every cache, against its fresh reference: determinism
controls.state_reuse: the same binding scored again at once on the warm prefix/state left by its fresh reference: cache reuse only
controls.batch_geometry: the same binding scoring each input as its own call from a cleared cache, against the batched fresh reference: native batch/sequence geometry only
controls.reference_path: the same binding through the uncached whole-sequence reference path, against the shared prefix/state/suffix path: native path only
controls.layout_numerics: every first scoring call of the A -> B -> base -> A cycles, against its binding's fresh reference: resident cache contents of other namespaces

diagnostic: per scored row: native finite/error shape, log probabilities and log answer mass; the canonical judge scores of that ScoreBlock row (semantic_switch.judge) as a probability observation (semantic_switch.metrics); and the public status, answer and acceptance of the policy reducer (semantic_switch.judgment.outcome) at the declared acceptance threshold
equivalence: equal native shape, errors, public status, answer and acceptance, and canonical probabilities and answer mass within the declared tolerance; log probabilities are reported, not gated
scope: fake-free native primitive measurement on standalone probe inputs; no check evidence, no specialist quality claim; correctness under deterministic probe adapters does not establish fitted-adapter accuracy
